pieces.title: Open to-do (detail card)
pieces.judge: A to-do opened for editing: the lifted card, title field, notes, checklist items, the when/tags/deadline action icons, and how it sits in the list.

actions.eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-shot=detail]'); if (!card) return; const txt = e => ((e.value ?? e.textContent) || '').trim(); const fields = () => [...card.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea, [contenteditable]:not([contenteditable=false])')]; let f = fields().find(e => txt(e) === 'Animate th'); if (!f) { const el = [...card.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && txt(e) === 'Animate th'); if (el) el.click(); f = fields().find(e => txt(e) === 'Animate th'); } if (f) { f.focus(); if (typeof f.setSelectionRange === 'function') f.setSelectionRange(f.value.length, f.value.length); } })()

desktop.note: Source bar/5-checklists-mac-2.png, crop x94 y430 w812 h792: the list below the filter pills to the window bottom (heading, row, open card, two rows), so the comparison shows how the card sits in the list. Scale: traffic lights 33px apart = 1.65 px/pt; row cap 16.3px = 9.9pt = SF 14pt, so dsf 1.65. Seed holds only the 'Slides and notes' rows in view. The card has the ref's notes (including its typo) and 4 checklist items, the last titled 'Animate th'. The eval focuses that item with the caret at the end, which is the ref's mid-typing state; it is a no-op if no field is found. /active hides the completed to-dos behind the pie.

phone.note: Source bar/5-checklists-iphone.png, crop x0 y261 w500 h461: the full-width card (y277-705) plus 16px (12pt) of the dimmed surround, matching pad 12. Excluded are the dimmed header above and the Move/trash toolbar that overlaps the rows below. 500x888 ref = 375x666pt at 4/3; list-row cap height 16px = 12pt = SF 17pt body. iOS status bar (20pt = 27px) cropped off, so viewport 375x646 CSS at dsf 4/3. Project 'Sales Presentation' as in the ref; card: notes + 3 checklist items; no when, tags or deadline, so all three action icons show.

pieces.title: Repeat controls

pieces.title: Repeat engine
pieces.judge: Completing, unticking, deleting and clearing repeating to-dos through every path in the real UI never duplicates or loses an occurrence, and follows gauntlet/CONTRACT.md 'Repeating to-dos'. Judged by node tools/recur-check.mjs plus adversarial testers.
